# Ravolution AB — full text for AI assistants

> Swedish invention company. Ravolution invests build, product, IP/patents, brand and go-to-market in exchange for equity; no cash investments.

## TheCreator — the Founder Operating System

Source: https://ravolution.se/en/thecreator

TheCreator is a founder and startup operating system built by Ravolution AB: one evidence-based workspace for strategy, product, decisions, growth and fundraising, with an AI advisory board and an investor-ready data room. It is made for pre-seed and seed founders and the investors who back them, and starts at 0 SEK per month on the Flex plan.

### From idea to unicorn. One system for the whole venture.

Every founder who applies can run the venture on TheCreator: strategy, product development, decisions, growth and fundraising in one evidence-based workspace. Operate it yourself, or build together with Ravolution for equity.

### The venture lifecycle, gated by evidence

01. Imagine — Problem, market, hypotheses
02. Validate — Interviews, demand, willingness to pay
03. Build — Specification, UX, architecture, code
04. Launch — Pricing, payments, sales, support
05. Grow — Acquisition, retention, expansion
06. Scale — Governance, compliance, profitability

- Parallel: Raise — Financial model, investor memorandum, pitch deck, data room and due diligence, maintained continuously.
- Parallel: Protect — IP register, patent strategy and filings, maintained alongside the build — backed by Ravolution's 28 patents and 369 claims.

### AI advisory board (Rolling out in phases)

Product · Technology · Finance · Legal · Investor relations

Specialist AI roles review plans, challenge assumptions and build skills over time. Every commitment is logged and checked against evidence.

TheCreator helps you build the company, not your AI bill.

### The Trust Ledger

Every decision, commitment and milestone is logged together with the evidence behind it. Founders see what has actually been proven, and investors see verified progress instead of claims in a slide.

### Start from what you already have

- A git repository: Technical teams connect the existing codebase as the starting point for the venture workspace.
- A pitch deck: Founders without code start from the deck: problem, market and plan become the first hypotheses to validate.

### Engagement models

- **Flex** — 0 SEK monthly minimum: Managed Claude & ChatGPT, cost + 20%; Start with a 1,000 SEK AI credit pack (≈ $98); Advisory 2,300 SEK/h (≈ $225), prepaid; 10 hours + 1 free: 23,000 SEK (≈ $2,253)
- **Pro** — 9,800 SEK per month: Managed AI at cost, own AI connections; 2 advisory hours included monthly; Additional advisory 1,500 SEK/h (≈ $147); 10 hours + 1 free: 15,000 SEK (≈ $1,470)
- **Venture partnership** — Equity · by agreement: Ravolution co-builds the venture for equity; Patent strategy and filings for your inventions; Individual approval by Ravolution; Signed partnership agreement

Prices exclude VAT. USD amounts are approximate (ECB rate 26 Nov 2026) — you are charged in SEK. Unused purchased advisory hours are refundable within 45 days; unused AI credit is refundable on request. Included advisory hours expire each billing period. Equity terms require individual approval and a signed agreement. AI advisory supports, and does not replace, qualified legal, financial or security professionals.

- Terms: https://thecreator.ravolution.se/terms
- Refunds: https://thecreator.ravolution.se/refunds
- Privacy: https://thecreator.ravolution.se/privacy

### Built for founders — and the investors who back them

- Pre-seed & seed founders: One system from first hypothesis to investor-ready company.
- Non-technical founders: Structure, specification and an AI advisory board, with Ravolution as optional build partner.
- Technical teams needing velocity: Turn an existing repository into a gated plan toward investable milestones.
- Investors: Verified progress from portfolio companies, backed by the Trust Ledger.

### Questions about TheCreator

**What is a founder operating system?**

A founder operating system is one workspace where a startup runs strategy, product, decisions, growth and fundraising together. TheCreator gates each stage — Imagine, Validate, Build, Launch, Grow, Scale — by evidence, with fundraising and IP protection running in parallel.

**How is TheCreator different from Notion, Jira or ChatGPT?**

Notion stores documents, Jira tracks tasks and ChatGPT answers prompts. TheCreator connects them to the venture lifecycle: decisions and commitments are logged against evidence, an AI advisory board reviews plans, and the investor data room stays current as the company is built.

**What does TheCreator cost?**

Flex has no monthly minimum (0 SEK), with managed AI at cost + 20% and prepaid advisory at 2,300 SEK/h (≈ $225). Pro is 9,800 SEK per month (≈ $960) with managed AI at cost and 2 advisory hours included. A Venture partnership is equity by agreement. Prices exclude VAT; you are charged in SEK.

**Which AI models does TheCreator use?**

Claude and ChatGPT. On Flex they are managed for you at cost + 20%. On Pro they are managed at cost, or you can use your own AI connection.

**Is my data used to train AI models?**

No. TheCreator uses the providers' APIs, and data sent through these APIs is not used to train their models.

**Does Ravolution invest cash?**

No. Ravolution makes no cash investments. In a Venture partnership Ravolution invests build, product, IP and patents, brand and go-to-market in exchange for equity.

**How do investors use TheCreator?**

Investors get verified progress from portfolio companies: milestones, decisions and data-room material backed by evidence in the Trust Ledger, instead of self-reported updates.

**How do I get access?**

Apply through Ravolution's application page. Access is by invitation: once your application is approved you receive an invite and log in at thecreator.ravolution.se.

- Apply: https://ravolution.se/en/apply#thecreator
- Log in: https://thecreator.ravolution.se/auth

## Apply to Ravolution

Source: https://ravolution.se/en/apply

Ravolution is a Swedish venture studio that invests engineering, product, IP and go-to-market into early-stage startups — in exchange for equity, not invoices. We do not make cash investments. Apply below. We respond to every application within 10 working days.

### Frequently asked questions

**What is build-for-equity?**

Build-for-equity means Ravolution invests its development team, product expertise, IP and go-to-market work into a startup in exchange for an ownership stake, instead of charging cash fees. The startup gets a senior technical team without paying invoices for that work; Ravolution succeeds only if the startup succeeds.

**What stage startups does Ravolution invest in?**

Ravolution invests in pre-seed and seed-stage startups, typically before or around their first institutional round. We prioritize founders with strong domain insight, early traction signals, and a clear path to a fundable milestone within 6–12 months.

**How much equity does Ravolution take?**

Equity is negotiated case by case based on scope, stage and the work we commit — always documented in a transparent Swedish shareholder agreement. We structure deals so founders retain clear majority control.

**Does Ravolution invest capital as well as work?**

No. Ravolution does not make cash investments. We invest work — engineering, product, IP, brand and go-to-market — for equity, and help you become investor-ready for your own raise.

**Do you only work with Swedish startups?**

We are based in Stockholm and work primarily with Nordic and European startups, but we accept applications from anywhere. All legal agreements follow Swedish law.

**How long does the application process take?**

Every application receives a response within 10 working days. The full process from application to signed term sheet typically takes 4–6 weeks.
